purpose: Original bundled demonstration artwork for Image Studio. These are static development-time assets, not evidence of local image inference.
generation_method: Built-in image_gen__imagegen tool; three independent generation calls; no reference image inputs.
distribution_basis: Created for the user-authorized Image Studio implementation and bundled as original demonstration assets. No third-party stock images, Cherry Studio brand assets, logos or screenshot crops are used.

files.title: 山湖晨雾
files.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original sample artwork for a desktop image-creation app. Create a refined landscape photograph of a quiet alpine lake at dawn, layered mountains fading into pale mist, small dark conifer silhouettes along the shore, a delicate warm light line meeting cool turquoise water, soft reflections and realistic atmospheric depth. Horizontal 3:2 composition, immersive image filling the entire canvas. Natural fine detail, restrained color grading, calm editorial photography, no exaggerated HDR. No people, no buildings, no typography, no border, no logo, no watermark.
files.review_notes: Reviewed full composition, subject, texture and absence of logos/text/watermarks; copied original PNG without image edits.
